name: Consent blocks neural generation until face and reference are selected
description: Confirm neural generation is consent-gated and no manual painting UI is present.
steps: Open the neural makeup studio on mobile
Verify there is a face upload and makeup reference upload, with no brush or mask canvas
Keep both photos unselected and leave consent unchecked
expected: The AI generation button remains disabled and the page says the photos will be processed in the cloud.

name: Switch preset and reference modes
description: Check that the user can switch from a chosen look to reference-based transfer.
steps: Open the neural makeup studio on desktop
Select عروس کلاسیک and verify it looks selected
Select از عکس مرجع and verify it looks selected
expected: Look choices are visibly selectable, and the interface offers image-reference transfer without manual painting.

name: Explain image-processing limitations before upload
description: Check the preview does not misrepresent a neural result as independently verified or offline.
steps: Read the hosted-model and cloud-consent wording
Read the research disclosure below the preview
expected: The UI clearly states that real photos are sent to a hosted neural model with consent, and that photorealism and identity preservation are not independently certified.

name: Comparison and download require a generated result
description: Ensure users cannot download an absent result or compare it to the source.
steps: Open the app without uploading images
Inspect the output preview and before-after slider
expected: A placeholder is shown and both the before-after slider and download action are disabled until generation succeeds.
